usedFor: Justdial captures local leads, and HubSpot stores them when “Create or Update Contact” follows “New Leads”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Leads” in Justdial, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each Justdial lead lands in HubSpot as a contact, and a repeat email updates the record.

watchOut: “Create or Update Contact” matches on email, so a Justdial lead without one cannot be matched.
